'''Bavik Vannor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and joined the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. He became one of the three gatekeepers contained within the [[Sith holocron (Tascollan Nebula)|Tascollan holocron]]. His [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] gatekeeper believed that the dark side was a great ally and knew a lot about [[Valik Kodank]]'s past.
